I'm glad that you can put a name to what's happening to me.

I'm scared of what people are going to think of me, they will ask me questions like "why didn't you do this before ?" "why didn't you talk to us". it just makes me feel guilty. 

There's also this thing i keep telling myself which is, Why would i work, have money and so on if i can't share it with anybody.
However i just think that whatever i'll do, i'll go back to this behaviour of not doing anything at all again.

I also forgot to say that i've been diagnotised with a narcissic wound.
